{{flag|Albania}}: Not required if holding a multiple entry C Schengen visa
{{flag|Andorra}}: The Andorran government imposes no visa requirements on its visitors and only requires a passport for entrance. However, since the country is only accessible via the Schengen countries Spain or France, entrance is not possible without entering the Schengen area first and the Schengen visa rules can therefore be regarded to apply de facto. Because Andorra is not part of the Schengen area, a multiple entry visa is required to reenter the Schengen area when leaving Andorra
{{flag|Australia}} and territories: May apply online (Online Visitor e600 visa).
{{flag|Azerbaijan}}: Holders of a pre-arranged approval may obtain visa on arrival.
{{flag|Belarus}}: Holders of a pre-arranged approval may obtain visa on arrival.

{{flag|Bosnia and Herzegovina}}: Not required if holding a multiple entry C Schengen visa
{{flag|Bulgaria}}: Not required if holding a multiple entry C Schengen visa (5 days entry)
{{flag|Cameroon}}: Holders of a pre-arranged approval issued by "Le Delegue General de la Surete" can obtain a visa on arrival.
{{flag|Costa Rica|state}}:
Visa free for Passengers with a valid visa issued by USA for at least 6 months from date of arrival for a maximum stay of 30 days
Costa Rican visas should be issued within 60 days after the date of issuance
Departure tax applies
{{flag|Croatia}}: Not required if holding a multiple entry C Schengen visa
{{flag|Cuba}}:
Visa not required for a maximum stay of 3 months within 6 months for holders of Diplomatic, Service, and Official
Tourist Cards (Tarjeta del Turista) must be obtained prior to arrival from diplomatic missions of Cuba, authorized airlines, or travel agencies. The card valid for a maximum stay of 30 days
Extensions of stay is possible up to a maximum of 60 days for a fee
Passengers who are former nationals of Cuba who left Cuba before 1971 must hold passports endorsed "Habilitado" for HE-11
Passengers must cover the length of their stay by 50 US Dollars per day or equivalent in other convertible currencies in cash or traveler's cheques unless they have previously contracted touristic activities with MINTUR in Cuba
Passengers are required to have a travel insurance to cover their medical expenses while in Cuba and should be purchased before departure
{{flag|Djibouti}}:
* Passengers with a passport valid for a minimum of 6 months from the arrival date can obtain a visa on arrival.
Must hold a return/onward ticket.
VoA are issued for stays of up to 1 month, 3 months or 6 months.
{{flag|Dominican Republic}}: Visa free for Passengers with a valid visa issued by Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Ireland (Rep.), Romania, USA, United Kingdom or a Schengen Member State
{{flag|El Salvador}}: Visa free for holders of a valid visa issued by Canada, the United States or a Schengen member state there is a processing fee of 10 $ to enter
{{flag|Eritrea}}: Holders of a confirmation of a pre-arranged visa can obtain a visa on arrival

{{flag|Honduras}}: Visa free for holders of a valid visa issued by Canada, the United States or a Schengen member state
{{flag|Israel}}: Confirmation from Israeli government is required before a visa is issued.
{{flag|Kazakhstan}}: Visitors arriving from a country without Kazakh representation and holding an invitation letter, can obtain a single entry visa on arrival for a max. stay of 1 month

{{flag|Romania}}:
